description: This file defines resource encoding configuration interfaces and implementations for Kubernetes API server, including version handling, resource encoding overrides, and compatibility considerations.

classes.name: DefaultResourceEncodingConfig
classes.description: Implementation of ResourceEncodingConfig that manages resource version encoding overrides and scheme-based version prioritization.

classes.name: OverridingResourceEncoding
classes.description: Data structure holding external and internal resource encoding versions.

classes.name: introducedInterface
classes.description: Interface for objects that can report their API lifecycle introduction version.

methods.name: NewDefaultResourceEncodingConfig
methods.description: Creates a new DefaultResourceEncodingConfig with the default effective version.

methods.name: NewDefaultResourceEncodingConfigForEffectiveVersion
methods.description: Creates a new DefaultResourceEncodingConfig with a specified effective version.

methods.name: SetResourceEncoding
methods.description: Sets external and internal encoding versions for a specific resource.

methods.name: SetEffectiveVersion
methods.description: Updates the effective version used for compatibility calculations.

methods.name: StorageEncodingFor
methods.description: Returns the storage encoding version for a given resource, considering overrides and scheme priorities.

methods.name: BackwardCompatibileStorageEncodingFor
methods.description: Returns the storage encoding version suitable for backward compatibility, considering overrides and scheme.

methods.name: InMemoryEncodingFor
methods.description: Returns the in-memory encoding version for a resource, defaulting to internal version if no override.
